title: Introduce per-token latency fingerprinting, contextual span annotations, and alert coalescer
author: Aditi Shah
description:
Summary:
Add a lightweight per-token latency fingerprint (PLF) and contextual span annotations to our invocation traces, plus a server-side alert coalescer that reduces noisy SLO alerts by grouping related invocations. Motivation: customers report high alert noise from token-level tail latency spikes that are often caused by the same underlying kernel queue/backpressure patterns or by repeated prompt shapes. PLF enables fast grouping in query-time diagnostics and in alert aggregation without retaining full traces.

What this PR does (single-string):
- Adds a deterministic fingerprint computed at the tail end of an invocation that captures: token sequence length bucket, kernel-queue-lag quantile, GPU scheduling lane id, and a compact prompt-shape hash. The fingerprint is intentionally compact (64-bit base58) to avoid high cardinality.
- Emits per-token micro-timings aggregated into a compact span annotation blob attached to the root span: phase timings (tokenize, kv-lookup, kernel-run, postprocess), and a small histogram of intra-invocation token latencies (3 bins). Annotations are indexed for fast lookup by the observability gateway.
- Introduces an Alert Coalescer component in the observability service that: consumes SLO-triggered alerts, looks up PLFs for recent invocations, and groups alerts that share the same fingerprint or high similarity of annotations. Coalescer also applies backoff (quiet windows) per-group to avoid alert thrash.
- Adds Console controls and a dashboard: PLF distribution view, fingerprint heatmap, per-fingerprint recent traces, and coalescer status panel (grouping rate, suppressed alerts).
- Instrumentation changes: trace schema v2 bump, index migration job to backfill PLF for last 7 days of sampled traces, and a lightweight sampling policy to retain one in 100 traces with expanded annotations for high-frequency fingerprints.

Checklist:
- [x] Compute PLF in runtime and attach to root span
- [x] Emit compact annotations for per-token phase timings
- [x] Implement coalescer service + config flags
- [x] Add Console dashboard and controls (feature-flagged)
- [x] E2E test with synthetic burst traces and alert generation
- [x] Migration job + monitoring for indexing errors
- [x] Docs: rollout plan, coalescer tuning docs, and migration notes

Commits (high level):
- feat(runtime): compute per-token latency fingerprint and attach to root span
- feat(telemetry): add token-phase annotation blob and compact histogram
- feat(observability): implement alert coalescer with grouping + quiet window logic
- feat(console): add PLF dashboard panels and coalescer controls behind feature flag
- chore(migration): add backfill job for index and add index-monitoring metric
- test: add synthetic trace generator and e2e test for alert grouping

Files changed (high-level):
- runtime/src/tracing/plf_generator.rs (key logic + tests)
- runtime/src/tracing/span_annotations.rs (annotation encoder)
- observability/coalescer/service.go (grouping + policy engine)
- observability/coalescer/config.yaml.example (tuning knobs)
- observability/indexer/migrations/2026-02-plf-backfill.sql (backfill job)
- console/frontend/src/pages/telemetry/PLFOverview.tsx (dashboard panels)
- console/backend/routes/telemetry_coalescer.go (API endpoints)
- telemetry/tests/synthetic_trace_generator.py (e2e harness)
- docs/observability/plf-and-coalescer.md (runbook + tuning)
- infra/helm/observability-values.yaml (feature-flag defaults)
- ci/e2e/plf_coalescer_test.yml (CI job)

Testing and validation:
- Unit tests added for PLF determinism and annotation encoding (runtime).
- Integration tests for the coalescer policy using the synthetic trace generator; validates grouping heuristics and quiet window backoff.
- CI: e2e job runs synthetic burst scenario (50k synthetic invocations) against a local coalescer binary and asserts that alert volume is reduced by >=65% when groupable.
- Manual verification: toggled feature flag in staging Console, validated dashboard heatmap and drilled into grouped traces.

Backward-compatibility and migration:
- Trace schema bump to v2; collectors that do not understand v2 will ignore annotation blob. We included a compatibility field in the root span for older indexers.
- Backfill: indexer migration populates PLF for sampled traces from the last 7 days; the job is rate-limited and exposes progress metrics.
- Feature gating: coalescer is off by default for customers; Console exposes a per-tenant opt-in toggle.

Rollout plan:
1) Merge and enable trace schema v2 in staging behind feature flag (2 days), monitor indexer errors.
2) Run backfill on sampled traces in staging; validate PLF distribution and histogram shapes (3 days).
3) Enable coalescer in staging and run synthetic workload; validate alert reduction and ensure no SLO regression.
4) Gradual canary to 10% of tenants (1 week) with telemetry gates on grouping-rate/false-coalesce-rate.
5) Full enable for all tenants with console defaults applied (2 weeks).

Operational notes and knobs:
- Coalescer config knobs: grouping-window (10s), quiet-window (300s), min-group-size (3), fingerprint-similarity-threshold (0.8).
- Monitoring: metrics added - coalescer.group_count, coalescer.suppressed_alerts, plf.cardinality, plf.top-100-freq. Alerts added for indexer-failure-rate > 0.5% and coalescer.false-coalesce-rate > 2%.

Related work and references:
- Related Linear tasks: ENG-3421 (PLF design), ENG-3490 (coalescer policy tuning).
- Incident reference: SUP-1287 where noisy token-tail alerts impacted an enterprise customer.

Notes on uniqueness and safety:
- Fingerprint intentionally omits any raw prompt text; we use a hash of prompt-shape and length bucketing to avoid PII leakage. The annotation blob is size-limited to 256 bytes and sanitized before emission.

If reviewers agree, I will follow up with a second PR to: 1) expose per-fingerprint cost-attribution in the billing pipeline, and 2) add a compact query API for searching by PLF in the public telemetry API.

review_comments: Miguel Alvarez: Nice work — the 64-bit fingerprint size seems reasonable but can we get an analysis of collision rate vs. cardinality?
Aditi Shah: Added a short collision analysis to docs (appendix) and a deterministic test harness. Collisions expected < 0.003% on sampled traces (details in docs).
Priya Raman: How do we avoid coalescing distinct semantic failures (e.g., model errors) which happen to share a fingerprint?
Aditi Shah: Coalescer excludes alerts with error-type tag != token-latency. We also require a min-group-size and will surface grouped members for manual triage. Added unit tests.
Ethan Cole: CI e2e flakes — observed occasional timing-dependent failures when synthetic generator saturates the local indexer. Consider rate-limiting test harness.
Aditi Shah: Added rate-limiter to the harness and retried e2e; CI now stable. Also tuned job parallelism for the backfill to avoid overload.
